GUSTFACTOR.description: Gust Effect Factor Calculation (GUSTFACTOR). Computes the along-wind gust effect factors in the X and Y directions per the KDS wind code; the request drives the wind design code, whether the structure is treated as rigid or flexible, and the corresponding rigid/flexible parameter set.

WIND_CODE.description: Wind design code. Enum is case-insensitive. Although the DTO defines many codes, the handler only supports KDS_2022 and throws a wrong-field error for any other value, so this is a hard constraint.

STRUCTURE_TYPE.description: Structure classification that selects which parameter block is consumed: RIGID uses RIGID_PARAM, FLEXIBLE uses FLEXIBLE_PARAM. Enum is case-insensitive.

RIGID_PARAM.description: [STRUCTURE_TYPE=RIGID] Rigid-structure parameters. Required by the handler when STRUCTURE_TYPE is RIGID (a wrong-field error is thrown if omitted).

EXP_CATEGORY.description: Exposure category (A=1, B=2, C=3, D=4). Enum is case-insensitive.

FLEXIBLE_PARAM.description: [STRUCTURE_TYPE=FLEXIBLE] Flexible-structure parameters. Required by the handler when STRUCTURE_TYPE is FLEXIBLE (a wrong-field error is thrown if omitted).

EXP_CATEGORY.description: Exposure category (A=1, B=2, C=3, D=4). Enum is case-insensitive.

TOPOGRAPHIC_EFFECT.description: Topographic effect option. When omitted, the effect is disabled (OPT_USE=false) and the topographic factor Kzt defaults to 1.0.

OPT_USE.description: Whether to apply the topographic effect.

KZT.description: Topographic factor Kzt. Required when OPT_USE is true; defaults to 1.0 when not provided.

DIRECTION_FACTOR_X.description: X-directional factor Kdx. Must be between 0.85 and 1.0.

DIRECTION_FACTOR_Y.description: Y-directional factor Kdy. Must be between 0.85 and 1.0.

FREQUENCY_X.description: Natural frequency in X (Hz). Must be greater than 0.

FREQUENCY_Y.description: Natural frequency in Y (Hz). Must be greater than 0.

DAMPING.description: Damping ratio. Must be greater than 0.

TOTAL_MASS.description: Total mass (kg). Must be greater than 0.

MX.description: Effective mass in X (kg). Must be greater than 0.

MY.description: Effective mass in Y (kg). Must be greater than 0.

VIBRATION.description: Vibration exponent. Must be between 0.5 and 2.0.
